visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair and large circular earrings sits on a floor in front of a brown sofa, holding a tiny black toy piano to the camera. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with a round wooden table in the foreground holding various toy capsules and unboxing debris. (2) She brings the miniature piano close to the lens, showing its keys and decorative patterns. Her facial expression is bright and smiling as she looks at the tiny object. (3) She gestures toward a collection of colorful gashapon capsules (blue, green, orange, red) laid out on the table. Yellow captions and graphics appear on the screen. (4) The camera cuts to a close-up of a white grand piano toy being opened. She demonstrates the moving lid and realistic keys. The woman is visible in a small circular inset at the top left. (5) She unboxes a black grand piano, showing the intricate detail of the pedals and the gold patterns on the lid. The background remains the same living room setting. (6) She reveals a green toy piano from an orange capsule. A static graphic of a man (celebrity photo) briefly overlays the screen for comedic effect. (7) She presents a red miniature pipe organ with gold pipes, holding it between her palms and swaying rhythmically. (8) A final demonstration shows two different pianos—one transparent and one black with numbered keys. She uses her fingers to play the keys which light up in sequence to show a melody.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced female narration begins with an excited, high-arousal tone. Upbeat, comedic synth BGM starts simultaneously. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs, immediately followed by a thin, tinny monophonic rendition of 'Oh, Susanna' played from a small device. (3) A sequence of pop sound effects punctuates the host's high-frequency speech as she presents colorful items. (4) As she unboxes the white piano, a high-fidelity classical piano track (Mozart) swells, overlapping her friendly, narrative tone. (5) A cartoon 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition. (6) A different classical melody with a grander feel (Chopin) plays as she describes a black model. The BGM tempo remains consistent under the speech. (7) A sudden, loud comical scream vocal SFX occurs, followed by a deeper piano melody (Beethoven). (8) A rich, synthetic organ-like sound plays (Mussorgsky) as she presents a red miniature. (9) Rapid electronic chirps and sequenced piano notes play as she demonstrates the light-up keys of the final product, concluding with the upbeat theme.
